limits: AV publication time is not the triggering activity time.
Sample hash matching does not by itself bind an event to one PID or prove a false positive.
Absent lifecycle spans can mean older instrumentation, truncation or interruption; they do not prove shutdown did not occur.
UTC timestamps can be adjusted; clock regression disables reliable elapsed-time interpretation.

sourceFindings.observation: The latest document revision and persisted checkpoint match. checkpointRecovery would find no new snapshot; retain would find no removed entry. Recovery State destruction skips metadata cleanup while its buffer index is nonempty.

WorkspaceFileIndex starts scanning through snapshot(), not construction. WorkspaceMonitor filters .cycode and only updates in-memory revisions. These five recorded methods do not request a file-index snapshot.

sourceFindings.topic: Recovery operations common to narrowed detected cases
sourceFindings.classification: candidate sequence, not a vendor verdict
sourceFindings.observation: Both checkpoint-then-save and re-checkpoint cases replace an existing recovery index and remove old text. Baseline deletion is absent in the re-checkpoint case; explicit document save and redundant consumed-temporary cleanup are also absent. The individual triggering call is not isolated.

existingEvidenceAvailability.visibleTraceInventory: Only KAV.dumpwriter.log was listed in the inspected Traces directory; its modification time predates the incident. No service diagnostic trace was found there; timestamps alone do not establish absence of all vendor data.

nextDiscriminatingComparison: Keep the first dirty document checkpoint; checkpoint a second dirty document. This replaces the index without deleting any old payload. Observe before shutdown. A separate refresh case uses ordinary old-text cleanup. Both require fresh explicit native resumption after the last detection.
vendorDocumentationVersionLimit: The accessible Kaspersky help references are Win21.7; they are general diagnostic guidance, not a verified Win21.26 component-trace recipe.
